The customer complains that during AC charging session, the MeterValue msg is skipping “Energy.Active.Import.Register”. I have also seen that during a charging session, the current value is non zero however the voltage value is 0.

v6.0.3

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0401610-DC/Si-D/FR [MP / P0 170001102] Configured Meter values not seen in OCPP message CRM:01410001410
additional_info.body:
Hello Olivier,
as OCPP 1.6 section 7.31. Measurands
Energy.Active.Import.Register:
Numerical value read from the "active electrical energy" (Wh or kWh) register of the (most authoritative)
electrical meter measuring energy imported
(from the grid supply). As i can see in your chargers configuration there is no Bauer meter on this charger. So therefore there will be no reported values on
Energy.Active.Import.Register
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih
